        graph[v].append(u)
    
    # Find leaf nodes (rooms with exactly one corridor)

    # If room 1 is a leaf node, Vlad cannot win
    if 1 in leaf_nodes:

                    queue.append((neighbor, distance + 1))
        
        return farthest_node, max_distance
    
    farthest_node, _ = bfs(1)
    farthest_node, diameter = bfs(farthest_node)
    
    # If the diameter is odd, Vlad can always win

    # Calculate the minimum number of friends needed
